[[File:Mattberry_plant.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A mattberry plant on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].]]
The '''mattberry plant''' was a plant that grew on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]].<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> It produced a fruit named [[Mattberry/Legends|mattberry]] used by the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] to make juice.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|294|mattberry}}</ref> The plant was featured on [[Vanvi Hotne]]'s painting ''[[Mattberry Plant]]''.<ref name="SWG:P6">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other}}Publish 6: "The Imperial Crackdown"</ref>
